# 以证据限定结论：生成式搜索的来源风险审计

原题：*Claim-Gated Source-Risk Auditing for Generative Search*。作者Kainan Zhou（Google）、Chuhong Xu（Sony Corporate of America）、Gangzhen Qian（Google）、Zhaoyi Li（Intuit）。本地版本arXiv:2609.29145v2，2026-10-09，共五页。以下译出全部正文、三式、四表、两图和致谢；参考书目完整保留在末尾逐页英文。作者机构署名不代表产品部署或机构背书。

> 本文实现的是“结构化记录按规则判定是否遗漏关系背景”的检查器，不是自动识别网页利益关系的AI。81/81和192/192是人工构造状态的有限符合性测试，不是识别现实来源风险100%准确。

## 第一部分：完整中文译文

### 摘要

生成式搜索可能引用一个确实支持主张的段落，却遗漏会改变其解释的来源关系。我们规定了一个面向“查询—来源—答案”三元组、由证据约束结论的审计。只有关系证据、答案采纳、实质重要性与披露都被观察到，遗漏判断才能确定；证据不完整保持未解决，不当作独立来源。

该规范将遗漏终点与引用支持、复核优先级分开，并将决定绑定到有版本的证据片段。参考检查器使记录契约可执行。在穷尽合成测试中复现全部81种三态谓词组合，拒绝192条故意损坏记录。共同完整性守卫的基线和谓词消融，把终点逻辑与缺失处理分离；受控变更检查支持分离及证据移除。这些是有限契约符合性，不是检测准确率或用户结果改善证据。我们说明建立语义效度和部署收益仍需独立标注、留出评估和成对效用测试。

关键词：生成式搜索、来源出处、审计规范、缺失证据、符合性测试。

### I 引言

生成式搜索把检索、来源选择、归因和生成组合成答案。现有可验证性审计询问“引用是否支持附属主张”；另一问题是，来源若与查询目标有关系，即使陈述正确，把它当独立评价也可能不合理。

假设产品推荐使用付费联盟推广者写的评论，答案采纳推荐却不说明关系，引用有支撑也不能解决缺失背景。相反，公司写的规格若明确来源，用于事实比较可能完全合适。所有权或商业性质单独都不构成遗漏。判断单位必须包含查询、来源以及答案如何使用来源。

引用生成基准测正确性与引用质量；发布者优化进入答案，也进一步说明保留来源背景的重要，但可见性或说服性措辞不能证明某种具体关系。审计要求可回溯的关系证据，并另行判断对已采纳主张是否重要。

本文贡献是可执行规范而非神经架构：四谓词遗漏终点及完整案例政策；分离来源证据、答案判断、事后复核优先级的记录契约；可重现的共同守卫基线、组件消融与畸形记录测试。给定明确判断，系统保持其意义，并只报告实际完成的验证阶段。

实现能复现公式，并不代表能从网页识别关系；证据指针有效也不保证人判断正确。本文测试前者，不测试后者。产物为后续语义评估基础，不估计遗漏流行率，不证明答案更好，也不给发布者可信度认证。

### II 相关工作与范围

**A 引用支持与RAG评估。** RAGTruth提供RAG幻觉语料，RAGAs评检索与生成，内容级测量关乎事实支持，却不自动提供本研究需要的已归档来源—目标关系。支持保留为独立字段，让事实和背景失败可一起查看但不混淆。ARES等学习评委可辅助找候选或标注，但预测仍与关系证据不同。参考检查器不运行它们，也不比较公开分数，因为输入任务不同。

**B 关系证据与披露。** 联盟推广滥用研究通过交易背景追关系，AdIntuition研究视频页面疑似代言披露。它们启发区分“找到关系”和“答案是否充分解释”。页面其他位置出现披露关键词，不足以证明答案保留了背景。

**C 行为测试与结论边界。** CheckList用定向行为测试发现总体分数掩盖的错误。这里在结构化记录层改变一个字段、预登记预期终点、保持其余不变。穷尽状态的答案由规范产生，符合它只证明实现遵守规范，不证明谓词有意义或可从自然语言可靠提取。

### III 审计规范与参考检查器

#### A 单位、谓词和完整案例终点

r=(q,u,a)，分别为查询、可供生成器访问或被答案引用的归档来源、生成答案。多来源分别建三元组。有版本的编码手册给四个谓词赋0、1、U：I=与查询相关的来源关系；A=答案是否采纳该来源主张；M=关系是否会改变解释；D=答案是否充分披露。U表示现有记录无法判断，不代表关系不存在。

$$RO(r)=\begin{cases}U,&I,A,M,D任一为U,\\IAM(1-D),&其余情况.\end{cases}\tag{1}$$

(1,1,1,0)为遗漏，(1,1,1,1)不是。(0,1,1,U)仍未解决，即便短路布尔可判零。这是刻意的完整文档要求：确定记录必须有四项判断，比“是否可能为真”更严格。

终点只涉及观察到的答案遗漏重要背景，不推断意图、不认定欺骗、不建立来源对生成器的因果影响。采纳和重要性各需证据，不能由关系标签自动推出。

#### B 证据向量与复核优先级

$$d(r)=(d_Q,d_I,d_A,d_M,d_G)\in([0,1]\cup\{U\})^5.\tag{2}$$

依次为查询敏感性、关系证据、采纳、重要性、披露缺口。已解决时dI=I、dA=A、dM=M、dG=1−D，未知对应U。它们不是类别概率，无须和为1。未来分级编码手册若要映射谓词，需单独验证。

五维全观察时，事后复核优先级为：

$$T_{post}(r)=\sum_k w_kd_k,\qquad w_k\ge0,\quad\sum_kw_k=1.\tag{3}$$

分数只排列复核，不改变式1。任一维缺失，即便其权重为零，优先级也未解决。实验等权只是演示配置，不是优化政策。查询敏感性可用于抽样；依赖答案的维度不能倒过来选择生成同一答案所用的证据。

图1：查询q、归档来源u、答案a进入有证据的三元组记录；关系、采纳、重要性、披露决定RO，dQ只影响优先级。检查器接收明确判断，不直接预测原始文本。

![[附件_58/原文第2页.png]]

#### C 模块接口与执行顺序

归档适配器存查询、来源与答案快照及管线配置；标注适配器提供编码手册版本、谓词值和证据跨度；契约检查器验证表示与追溯性。只有合规记录进入终点与优先级计算，再进入结论台账。

顺序确定：检查必填与哈希；检查谓词类型和证据偏移；核对维度映射及权重；解析RO；计算优先级；附加已经完成的验证门槛。损坏记录以原因拒绝，不转换为语义标签。结构有效但判断未知的记录接受并返回U，防止解析失败悄悄变成阴性。

已实现适配器生成合成记录并直接供应判断。网页采集、实体解析、自然语言标注和答案生成只是外部接口，不是已实现能力。可选学习标注器要冻结并与独立标签比较之后，才能宣称准确率。

#### D 来源角色及可接受证据

角色决定寻找哪些证据、编码手册应要求哪些披露，不是独立风险分。当前所有权证据可能解决I，但A/M/D仍需看具体答案。

|表I：角色|操作解释|
|---|---|
|目标所有者|观察到与目标有关来源的所有权|
|目标关联方|有证据的相关方推广或比较目标|
|受赞助第三方|有证据的重要赞助关系|
|倡议立场一致方|可观察组织或议题立场一致|
|商业第三方|商业出版者，具体关系未定|
|表面独立|没有明显所有权声明，但归档证据显示重要联系|
|未观察到关系|按规定查找未发现联系，独立性仍未验证|
|社区/UGC|身份或协同关系仍不确定|

证据须来自可回溯归档，例如所有权记录、赞助声明、联盟记录、可重现身份元数据。语气、排名、相似度和商业性质能引导调查，不能解决关系判断。决定绑定生成答案时对应的来源版本和时间窗口；后来证据产生新版本，不能改写早期观察。

#### E 记录契约与不变量

记录保存查询/三元组ID、原URL与规范URL、排名、采集时间、来源和答案快照、管线元数据、来源角色、编码版本、谓词和证据偏移。每个已解决判断有可恢复片段；合成未知使用JSON null。缺字段、字符串“U”和数值零不可互换。

快照摘要用SHA-256。三元组摘要绑定查询身份、来源及答案摘要、管线配置；记录摘要再绑定标注与其他字段。修改标注保留三元组身份、改变记录身份并指向父版本。哈希检测变化，不保证真实性或语义正确；只追加存储还需部署实现。

六项不变量：引用支持与来源风险分离；结果仅限本三元组；保留证据指针；缺失证据不能产生已解决低风险结论；生成与事后复核分离；更强实证结论要求更强验证。测试只覆盖指定转换，不证明所有可能实现都遵守这些原则。

### IV 可执行符合性评估

#### A 问题、夹具与测试判据

测试检查器是否实现宣告终点、简化规则是否保留契约、验证器是否拒绝选定结构缺陷。穷举{0,1,U}⁴，81组合中1阳性、15阴性、65未解决。每个配合成查询、来源、答案、版本与明确判断片段；文本含测试夹具标记，不是真网页主张。

无训练、真实数据预处理或训练测试切分。有限契约枚举不需拟合或统计采样。期望输出另存，以完全观察时属于显式阳性集合{(1,1,1,0)}判断，否则未知。这是同一规则的独立表达测试判据，不是独立语义金标；没有人类标签或实时网页观察。

实验Python3.13.5标准库，生成JSONL夹具、期望表、逐例预测、变更日志、CSV、校验清单，论文表由输出生成。无需付费API、预训练模型或网络。

#### B 基线及共同守卫

仅支持规则：段落支持时返回零，主夹具支持固定1；仅关系返回I；仅披露在D已知时返回1−D，否则U。后者是已知特征上的代理规则，不是已执行关键词检测器。全部消耗同样结构化判断，比较的是丢弃信息后果，不是语言理解。

|表II：方法|E16|F65|U81|
|---|---:|---:|---:|
|完整案例参考|0|0|65|
|仅支持|1|65|0|
|仅关系|7|38|27|
|仅披露|7|38|27|
|仅支持+共同守卫|1|0|65|
|仅关系+共同守卫|7|0|65|
|仅披露+共同守卫|7|0|65|
|去掉I+守卫|1|0|65|
|去掉A+守卫|1|0|65|
|去掉M+守卫|1|0|65|
|去掉D+守卫|1|0|65|
|去掉dQ，只影响优先级|0|0|65|

E16为16完整状态上的不一致；F65为65不完整状态上违反契约却给确定结果的数量；U81为总未知输出。它们是规范计数，不是估计检测错误率。

给三基线同样四谓词完整性守卫，控制缺失政策，避免仅因参考更严格而给其优势。无守卫，支持规则漏唯一阳性且解决全部65未知；关系/披露各错7完整、解决38未知。加守卫消除后者，但完整状态错误仍在。支持+守卫看似15/16正确，只因本枚举阳性稀少，不说明支持可取代关系审计。

#### C 谓词消融及覆盖取舍

每次保留同守卫，去掉一个布尔条件：去I/A/M用1替代，去D用0替代。各自在16完整状态新增一个阳性。例如去A会把(1,0,1,0)判遗漏，尽管答案没采纳来源。去dQ不改终点，如设计所需；这是分离控制，不证明查询敏感性对分诊有用。

另一合法政策是I=0或A=0或M=0或D=1即短路阴性，其他未知也可结束。这样81状态中66可确定，而完整案例只有16。新增50个阴性不是布尔错误，而是完整记录要求的代价。合成覆盖数不是部署比例，严格政策不被声称处处优越。

#### D 受控转换与结构变异

|表III：有限符合性检查|通过/测试|
|---|---:|
|完整真值表|81/81|
|移除证据|216/216|
|支持分离|81/81|
|查询优先级分离|891/891|
|受控二元对|32/32|
|规范序列化往返|81/81|
|标注版本谱系|81/81|
|拒绝畸形记录|192/192|

替换一个已知谓词为U得到216条有向移除转换，目的状态全部未解决。切换段落支持不改81终点；dQ从0到1、步长.1共891检查，不改终点。计数共享基础状态，不能当独立观察。

二元套件固定其他三项、翻一个谓词，共32对。D从0到1只在I=A=M=1时去除遗漏，其他七对保持阴性；其他谓词检查对应方向。这是已供应判断的记录干预，不是用户评估的成对生成答案。

81有效记录均通过规范序列化与谱系检查。16完整记录各施加12缺陷，共192：身份、快照及记录摘要、缺编码/管线字段、非法可空标签、维度不一致、缺失或非法跨度、引用文本不匹配、未归一权重等，全部拒绝。除故意身份/摘要错误外，变更后重新封装摘要，避免过期外层摘要遮蔽真正结构测试。精选套件不是任意输入模糊测试，也不是安全证明。

#### E 成本与解释

Intel Xeon Platinum8573C单进程微基准，预热后21次批均值；终点每重复16,200三元组，完整检查每重复810。批均值中位数：终点每三元组.49微秒，验证加审计51.20微秒。排除归档I/O、检索、生成、标注，不是端到端延迟，也不是请求尾延迟。

成功标准是符合所选规范。错误的重要性标签仍可通过全部结构检查。穷举计数不附置信区间或显著性，不把重复模板当巨大实证样本。完成的结论仅为该实现有限符合性。

### V 语义验证与应用边界

#### A 独立标签与留出评估

图2下一阶段尚未完成：按领域和预设风险层分层抽样，归档在标注之前，记录纳入概率。目标家族、相关域名、查询模板不得从校准泄漏至留出测试；合成夹具不进入人类金标测试。

每三元组至少两名受训标注者独立，盲于模型分数和彼此决定，可以赋U，并为已解决项提供证据；之后裁决。可靠性在原独立标签上、按尺度选择系数报告。打开测试标签前冻结编码手册、管线及阈值。

分别评价每谓词和派生终点，用混淆矩阵、分类计数、未解决覆盖、按领域聚类区间，暴露总体指标隐藏错误。学习评委不能自己成为金标；LLM评估存在偏差。若辅助标注，需另有独立标注审计子集并公开辅助方式。

图2流程为分层样本→至少两名盲标者→裁决金标→版本化模型与阈值→一致度、错误、准确率、校准。可报告何种结论由证据决定。

![[附件_58/原文第4页.png]]

#### B 工具效用与部署

应用收益要把干预前后答案做匹配比较，固定生成条件，评委盲于分组。主要终点为重要关系遗漏；效用还包括可回答性、保留证据、事实支持、弃答及端到端延迟。只压制答案或删掉相关来源不能证明防御有用。

可用接口PASS、CONTEXTUALIZE、REVIEW、ABSTAIN。PASS只表示该三元组满足配置复核要求，不表示出版者独立或永远可靠；CONTEXTUALIZE补充分清关系且保留有用证据；REVIEW保留未知；ABSTAIN需明确的可回答性或证据政策。这些是建议接口，不是已验证生产控制。

#### C 局限、可证伪性和发布

|表IV：结论|所需证据|状态|
|---|---|---|
|有限符合性|可执行判据、夹具预测、变异日志|完成|
|真实网页发现|归档观察、时间戳、检索出处|未测试|
|语义效度|独立标注、可靠性、裁决|未测试|
|检测准确率|冻结系统、留出标签、分类指标与区间|未测试|
|应用收益|匹配干预、遗漏与效用指标|未测试|

现产物验证类型化合成记录与确定逻辑，不建立来源发现、真实关系时间有效性、标注可靠性、多语言迁移或读者理解变化。重要性与充分披露依任务而定，哈希有效可以完美保存错误或过时判断。

反证情形包括：标注者无法一致用M；分类系统性漏相关联系；更简单出处规则在独立标签上一样好；完整案例带来不可承受复核量；补背景伤害效用而未减少遗漏。出现这些应修订规则，而非把符合性当有用证明。

配套包含检查器、夹具生成器、判据、逐例输出、CSV、表生成脚本；校验清单绑定每次文件，不是数字签名。未来网页发布还需记录归档权限、排除、编码变化、裁决和切分。受限证据可保留授权指针，但脱敏不得悄悄改变报告样本。

### VI 结论与致谢

来源风险审计问的不仅是引用支持措辞，还包括答案是否保留重要关系。本文以查询—来源—答案形式化，提供缺失显式、证据指针、复核优先级分离的检查器。枚举、共同守卫、消融、结构变异建立有限符合性，也揭示完整案例覆盖成本。要主张语义准确、遗漏流行率或应用收益，仍需独立人标与成对答案评估。研究获北京理工大学珠海学院项目2026039DCXM支持。

## 第二部分：小白详细教学

### I—II：一句话有出处，不等于出处是独立评价

教学虚构：你问“甲软件是否最适合小型施工队”。AI引用一篇联盟推广文章，“我们推荐甲软件”，这个引用确实支持“该文章推荐甲”，却未必支持“独立评测认定甲最优”。审计应同时看事实支持和关系背景。

反例：查询“甲软件支持哪些导出格式”，公司官方说明通常是相关的一手来源。明确“官方文档列出CSV导出”，并没有因为公司与产品有关系就不合格。不能把商业来源全部删掉。

练习：对自己笔记中的三个引用，分别写“这段证明哪句话”和“作者与目标的关系是否有证据”。第二列查不到写未知，不写独立。

### III-A：四个开关怎样一起工作？

I问关系是否已证实；A问答案是否采纳主张；M问该关系会不会改变解释；D问答案有没有把重要关系说明白。只有1、1、1、0组合确定遗漏。

例一：有付费合作证据；答案采纳推荐；关系会改变读者对独立性的理解；答案没说。RO=1×1×1×(1−0)=1。

例二：同样四项但明确“该评测受甲赞助”，若按编码手册判披露充分，D=1，RO=0。零只表示这类遗漏没有成立，不证明推荐正确。

例三：没找到足够关系材料，I=U，其余即使全清楚也RO=U。格式缺字段则是无效记录，不是U，两者不能混淆。

练习：自己造四种案例，各写证据，不只填数字。特别做一个A=0案例：答案仅指出“这是一篇宣传文”，没有采用其推荐，去掉A就会误报。

### III-B—E：优先级不是定罪分数，哈希不是可信证明

假设d=(.8,1,1,1,1)，等权.2，Tpost=.96，表示优先复核。另一条d=(1,1,1,0,1)，分数.8却RO=0，因为M=0。高分并不覆盖终点条件。dQ未知时优先级未知，但若四谓词完整，RO仍可确定；它们是独立输出。

证据指针应让你回到具体句子：文件版本、时间、开始/结束位置、引文。仅存网页URL，网页改版后可能无法复查；只存哈希也只能检验文件是否相同，不能知道文件内容是真是假。

练习：在Obsidian一篇资料末尾建“来源背景”小表，字段为来源URL、归档日期、关系证据原句、答案采用句、重要性理由、披露句、判断状态。这里只是学习笔记，不对现实机构作无证据指控。

### IV：为什么81个都过，仍不是AI识别准确率100%？

四开关各三态，所以3⁴=81；全已知只有2⁴=16，其余65未知。唯一阳性是1110，其余15完整阴性。始终回答“没有遗漏”，对完整组合仍有15/16=93.75%表面正确，却漏掉全部阳性。这是为什么看总准确率不够。

216移除转换可手算：选四个字段之一，每字段取已知0或1，其余三字段三态，4×2×3³=216。891优先级测试=81×11。192畸形记录=16×12。它们是构造计数，不是几百名用户、几百个独立真实网站。

可用下面教学代码复核真值数量，它不是论文完整检查器：

```python
from itertools import product
from collections import Counter

def omission(I, A, M, D):
    if any(x is None for x in (I, A, M, D)):
        return None
    return I * A * M * (1 - D)

states = product((0, 1, None), repeat=4)
print(Counter(omission(*s) for s in states))
# Counter({None: 65, 0: 15, 1: 1})
```

练习：把缺证据改成0再数，观察未解决状态消失；这就是本文要避免的“因为不知道，所以说没问题”。代码仅用于学习，没有在本稿中假称运行作者配套完整测试。

### IV-C：完整记录和短路判断各有什么代价？

(0,1,1,U)中I已0，从逻辑上不可能成为1110，可短路判阴；论文仍保留U，是因为它要求四项文档齐全。短路能给更多答案，完整要求便于审计，却增加工作量。这是一项政策选择，不是数学上完整案例更正确。

练习：在资料库区分“逻辑上已排除该种遗漏”和“四项证据全备”两个字段。若将来实现系统，先写清采用哪种政策，不能把两种覆盖率直接当性能比较。

### V—VI：怎样落实到你的GEO文章收集？

第一步照常保留原文、作者和链接。第二步只对会影响你采纳判断的主张审查来源，例如“某工具优于同行”；纯定义或明确官方规格不必自动升级为风险。第三步找可核查的关系材料，记时间，不靠语气猜。第四步写清哪些是作者自述、合作方评价、独立测试，哪些仍未知。第五步在引用到自己的教程时，让读者看见会改变解释的背景，同时保留有用事实。

教学改写：“独立研究证明甲最好”若证据其实只有甲公司文章，应改为“甲公司的产品说明声称……；此处尚无独立比较数据”。不是把原文删除，而是准确标注证据层级。

如果要评价自动审计工具，至少找两人独立判同批案例，再裁决；模型预测不能当自己的标准答案。检查减少遗漏是否同时让答案更常拒答、丢了有效一手资料，不能只追求一个风险数字下降。

## 第三部分：不能越过的结论边界

本论文没有测试真实网页发现、自然语言关系识别、人类标注一致度、多语言或用户效用；微秒数也不含实际收集、标注、检索和生成。可以学其记录方式、缺失处理和证据分层，不能宣传为成熟自动风险检测产品。

“未观察到关系”不等于“证实独立”；“有关系”不等于“撒谎”；“RO=0”不等于“可信”；“结构验证通过”不等于“事实正确”；“哈希一致”不等于“真实签署”。这些区分也是整理GEO资料时防止把营销说法升级成研究结论的实用习惯。

Abstract—A generative search answer can cite a supported
passage yet omit a source relationship that changes its inter-
pretation. We specify a claim-gated audit of the query–source–
answer tuple. An omission is resolved only when relationship
evidence, answer adoption, materiality, and disclosure are all
observed; incomplete evidence remains unresolved rather than
being treated as independence. The specification separates this
endpoint from citation support and review priority, and binds
decisions to versioned evidence spans. A reference checker makes
the record contract executable. On an exhaustive synthetic
suite, it reproduces all 81 three-state predicate combinations
and rejects 192 deliberately malformed records. Common-guard
baselines and predicate ablations isolate endpoint logic from
missing-evidence handling, while controlled transitions check
support separation and evidence removal. These are finite
contract-conformance results, not detector accuracy or evidence
of improved user outcomes. We define the independent annotation,
held-out evaluation, and paired utility tests still required to
establish semantic validity and deployment benefit.
Index Terms—generative search, source provenance, audit
specification, missing evidence, conformance testing
I. INTRODUCTION
Generative search combines retrieval, source selection, attri-
bution, and generation in a single answer. Existing verifiability
audits ask whether citations support the statements attached
to them [1]. A different question arises when a supported
statement comes from a source with a relationship to the
queried target. The statement may be accurate, but interpreting
it as an independent assessment may still be unwarranted.
Consider an illustrative answer that recommends a product
using a review written by a paid affiliate. If the answer adopts
the recommendation without identifying the relationship, cita-
tion support does not resolve the missing context. Conversely, a
company-authored specification can be used appropriately when
its origin is clear and the answer makes a factual comparison.
Neither ownership nor commercial status alone establishes an
omission. The relevant unit must include the query, the source,
and the answer’s treatment of that source.
Citation-generation benchmarks measure correctness and
citation quality [2]. Publisher-side optimization of answer
inclusion provides a further reason to retain source context
[3], but visibility or persuasive language is not evidence of a
particular relationship. The audit therefore requires recoverable
relationship evidence and a separate judgment of whether its
omission matters for the adopted claim.
This paper contributes an executable specification rather
than a new neural architecture. Its first contribution is a
four-predicate omission endpoint with an explicit complete-
case policy. Its second is a record contract that separates
source evidence, answer-level judgments, and post hoc review
priority. Its third is a reproducible conformance suite with
common-guard baselines, component ablations, and malformed-
record tests. These components make a narrower claim than a
deployed detector: given explicit judgments, the implementation
preserves their meaning and reports only the validation stage
actually completed.
The distinction matters for evaluation. An implementation
can reproduce a formula without recognizing relationships in
Web text, and a valid evidence pointer can lead to an incorrect
human judgment. We test the former, not the latter. The
resulting artifact is a basis for subsequent semantic evaluation;
it does not estimate omission prevalence, demonstrate better
answers, or certify publisher trustworthiness.
II. RELATED WORK AND SCOPE
A. Citation Support and RAG Evaluation
RAGTruth supplies a hallucination corpus for retrieval-
augmented generation [4], while RAGAs evaluates retrieval and
generation components [5]. Their content-level measurements
are relevant to factual support but do not by themselves supply
the archived source–target relationship required here. Support
is retained as a separate field so that factual and contextual
failures can be inspected together without being conflated.
ARES uses learned evaluators for retrieval-augmented sys-
tems [6]. Such evaluators could help identify candidate tuples or
assist an annotator, but their predictions would remain distinct
from relationship evidence. Our reference checker does not run
these systems or compare their published scores: its inputs are
structured judgments, whereas their evaluation tasks involve
generated text and retrieved passages.
B. Relationship Evidence and Disclosure
Research on affiliate abuse traces relationships through
transaction context [7]. AdIntuition studies disclosure of likely
endorsements on video pages [8]. These settings motivate a
separation between finding a relationship and deciding whether
the audited answer explains it adequately. A disclosure keyword
elsewhere on a page is not sufficient evidence that the answer
preserves the relevant context.

C. Behavioral Tests and the Claim Boundary
CheckList uses targeted behavioral tests to expose failures
that an aggregate metric can miss [9]. We adopt that testing
principle at the structured-record level: change one field,
register the expected endpoint transition, and preserve the
rest. Unlike a natural-language benchmark, our exhaustive
state space has specification-derived outcomes. Agreement
with those outcomes establishes implementation conformance
only; it cannot establish that the predicates are meaningful or
reliably recoverable from natural text.

records whether the relationship affects interpretation; and D
records adequate disclosure in the answer. Here U means that
the available record does not resolve the judgment, not that
the relationship is absent.

C. Module Interfaces and Execution Order
Figure 1 separates the inputs and outputs. An archive
adapter stores the query, source and answer snapshots, and
pipeline configuration. An annotation adapter supplies the
codebook version, predicate values, and evidence spans. The
contract checker verifies representation and traceability. Only
a conforming record reaches the endpoint resolver and priority
scorer; their outputs then enter a claim ledger.
The execution order is deterministic: validate required fields
and hashes; validate predicate types and evidence offsets; verify
the dimension mapping and weights; resolve RO; compute
priority; and attach the completed validation gate. A malformed
record is rejected with a reason rather than converted into a
semantic label. A structurally valid record with unresolved
judgments is accepted and returns U. This distinction prevents
parsing failures from silently becoming negative findings.
The implemented adapter generates synthetic records and
supplies their judgments directly. Web collection, entity res-
olution, natural-language annotation, and generation remain
external interfaces, not implemented capabilities of this checker.
An optional learned annotator would need to be frozen and
evaluated against independent labels before any accuracy claim.
D. Source Roles and Admissible Evidence
Table I retains the operational source-role taxonomy. Roles
determine what evidence to seek and what disclosure the
codebook should require. They are not standalone risk scores.
Current ownership evidence may resolve I, but A, M, and D
still concern the particular answer.
Evidence must be recoverable from an archived observation:
for example, ownership records, sponsorship disclosures, af-
filiate records, or reproducible identity metadata. Tone, rank,
similarity, and commercial status may guide investigation but
do not resolve a relationship. Each decision is tied to the source
version and time window used for the answer. Later evidence
creates a new record version rather than rewriting the earlier
observation.

E. Record Contract and Invariants
The contract stores query and tuple identifiers, original and
canonical URLs, rank, collection time, source and answer
snapshots, pipeline metadata, source role, codebook version,
predicate judgments, and evidence offsets. Every resolved judg-
ment has a recoverable span; unresolved synthetic judgments
use JSON null. Missing keys, the string "U", and numeric
zero are not interchangeable.
The reference implementation derives snapshot digests with
SHA-256. A tuple digest binds the query identity, source and
answer digests, and pipeline configuration; a record digest
additionally binds annotations and other stored fields. An
annotation revision retains the tuple identity, changes the
record identity, and points to its parent. Hashes support change
detection, not authenticity or semantic correctness. Append-
only storage enforcement remains a deployment responsibility.
Six invariants constrain the design: citation support is
separate from source risk; findings remain tuple-local; decisions
retain evidence pointers; missing evidence cannot create a
resolved low-risk conclusion; generation and post hoc review
remain separate; and stronger empirical claims require stronger
validation. The conformance suite tests the specified record
transitions, not every possible implementation of these princi-
ples.

Web claims.

E. Measured Checker Cost and Interpretation
A single-process microbenchmark on an Intel Xeon Platinum
8573C host records 21 repeated batch means after warm-up.
The endpoint loop processes 16,200 tuples per repeat; the
full record checker processes 810. The median batch-mean
cost is 0.49 µs per tuple for the endpoint and 51.20 µs for
validation plus auditing. These measurements exclude archive
I/O, retrieval, generation, and annotation; they are neither end-
to-end latency nor per-request tail-latency estimates.
The experiment now supplies an executable record checker
and numerical comparisons, but its success criterion is agree-
ment with a chosen specification. An incorrect materiality
label can still pass every structural test. No confidence interval
or significance test is attached to the exhaustive counts, and
repeated template cases are not used to claim a large empirical
sample. The completed claim is finite conformance of the
supplied implementation.
V. SEMANTIC VALIDATION AND APPLICATION BOUNDARY
A. Independent Labels and Held-Out Evaluation
Figure 2 shows the next validation stage, which has not been
completed. A Web study must archive observations before
annotation, stratify by application domain and prespecified
risk bands, and record inclusion probabilities. Target families,
related domains, and query templates should not leak from
calibration into the held-out partition. Synthetic fixtures remain
outside the human-gold test set.
At least two trained annotators should label each tuple
independently, blinded to model scores and one another’s
decisions. They must be able to assign U and cite evidence for
resolved predicates. Adjudication follows, while reliability is
reported on the original independent labels using a coefficient
appropriate to the label scale [10]. The codebook, pipeline,

B. Tool Utility and Deployment Decisions
Application benefit requires a matched comparison of gener-
ated answers before and after an audit-informed intervention,
with generation settings held fixed and evaluators blinded
to condition. The primary endpoint is material relationship
omission; utility measures include answerability, retained
evidence, factual support, abstention, and end-to-end latency.
Merely suppressing answers or removing related sources does
not establish a useful defense.
A policy may return PASS, CONTEXTUALIZE, REVIEW,
or ABSTAIN. PASS means that the configured review require-
ment is met for the observed tuple, not that the publisher is
independent or universally reliable. CONTEXTUALIZE can
request adequate relationship attribution while retaining useful
evidence. REVIEW preserves unresolved cases; ABSTAIN
requires an explicit answerability or evidence policy. These
actions are proposed interfaces, not validated production
controls.
C. Limitations, Falsifiability, and Release
Table IV makes the remaining claim boundaries explicit.
The present artifact validates typed synthetic records and deter-
ministic logic. It does not establish source discovery, temporal
validity of real relationships, annotation reliability, multilingual
transfer, or changes in reader interpretation. Materiality and
adequate disclosure remain task-dependent judgments. A hash-
valid record can preserve an erroneous or outdated judgment
perfectly.
Several findings would count against the specification:
annotators cannot apply M consistently; the role taxonomy
systematically excludes relevant ties; a simpler provenance
rule performs equally well against independent labels; the
complete-case requirement causes impractical review load;
or contextualization harms answer utility without reducing
omissions. Any such result requires revising the affected rule
rather than treating conformance as proof of usefulness.
The accompanying package includes the checker, fixture
generator, test oracle, per-case outputs, aggregate CSVs, and
table-generation script. A checksum manifest binds the files
used for each run; it is not a digital signature.
The future Web release must additionally document archive
permissions, exclusions, codebook changes, adjudication, and
split assignments. Restricted evidence can retain authorized
pointers, but redaction must not silently change the reported
sample.
VI. CONCLUSION
Source-risk auditing asks whether a generated answer
preserves a material relationship, not only whether a citation
supports its words. We formalize that question at the query–
source–answer level and implement a record checker with
explicit missingness, evidence pointers, and separate review
priority. Exhaustive predicate enumeration, common-guard
comparisons, component ablations, and structural mutations
establish finite conformance of the implementation. They
also expose the coverage cost of a complete-case policy.
Independent human labels and paired answer-level evaluations
remain necessary before claiming semantic accuracy, omission
prevalence, or application benefit.
